title: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon — Park & Ride page (2026)
claims: Park & Ride costs R50 from UCT, Theo Marais Park, CTICC, Civic Centre and Century City.
At UCT, Theo Marais Park and Century City the first bus departs at 04:00 and the last bus at 04:30; at CTICC and Civic Centre the first bus departs at 04:00 and the last bus at 05:00.
Return buses run from 10:00 to 14:30 at all five Park & Ride points.
Each Park & Ride point has secure parking and toilets.
The page warns that road closures leave little or no access to parking near the start/finish area, and that congestion in Green Point can mean missing the start.
